data.title: Add bounded saved ECS watch queries
data.description: Named bounded ECS projections with explicit temporal deltas across RPC step/sample/list/remove, one-shot run, and playtest. Includes rewind semantics and Radiant wave/storm/nova regressions. Full just check passed twice.

data.body: INFO: define_ecs_watch() runs the validating ecs_query before ecs_watches.define() checks the duplicate-name and MAX_WATCHES limits. A duplicate or over-limit define therefore does a redundant read-only query, and if the query itself is invalid you surface the world/query error rather than the more relevant "already exists"/"limit reached" error. Harmless (read-only, no state mutation on the reject path) and the over-limit test still passes — just a minor ordering nit if error clarity matters later.

data.reason: Bounded named ECS watches are correct, well-tested, and clippy-clean. Budgets (32 defs / 128 entities / 128 changed IDs) match console-core constants and the Lua inspector. Truncation, entity_delta_limit=0, reset/load_state baseline clearing, and load_cart clearing are all handled and covered by tests (5/5 pass, incl. Radiant wave/storm/nova regression). One INFO ordering nit, non-blocking.

data.body: Agreed. Keeping the read-only validation order in this patch because changing it requires a second preflight API on WatchStore; the current behavior is bounded, side-effect free, and covered. We can improve rejection priority if it becomes confusing in practice.

data.reason: Acknowledged as a non-blocking error-priority refinement; no correctness or bound impact.
